About.title: About DisposeMail
About.mission_desc: In an age of constant surveillance and data breaches, DisposeMail was built with a single mission: to protect your primary inbox and personal identity. We believe that privacy is a fundamental human right, not a luxury. Our service provides a temporary shield between your real self and the vast, often tracking-heavy world of the internet.
About.why_exist_desc: Every time you sign up for a newsletter, trial, or app, you risk exposing your email to spammers, trackers, and potential hackers. Once your email is on a 'list,' it's there forever. DisposeMail provides an instant, secure buffer that allows you to access the web without the long-term baggage of spam.
About.tech_desc: We utilize modern cloud infrastructure leveraging Cloudflare Edge networks and secure VPS nodes to route emails instantly. Unlike other providers, we don't store your data in a persistent database. Our high-performance WebSocket architecture ensures that when an email arrives, it's displayed on your screen in real-time.
About.item1: Zero Logs: We don't log IP addresses or user agents.
About.item2: Auto-Purge: Every bit of data is shredded every 60 minutes.
About.item3: No Registration: We don't ask for your name, phone number, or real email.
About.item4: Encrypted: All traffic is served over SSL/TLS for maximum security.
About.transparency_desc: We believe privacy tools should be transparent. While we operate a complex infrastructure to maintain speed and reliability, we are committed to remaining an open and community-focused platform. If you have questions about how our service works, feel free to reach out to our team.

FAQ.title: Help Center & FAQ
FAQ.a1: Every address and every received email is automatically purged from our system after exactly **60 minutes**. This ensures that no legacy data remains on our servers for prying eyes.
FAQ.a2: Yes, DisposeMail is a forever-free tool powered by high-quality ads to keep our infrastructure growing.
FAQ.a3: DisposeMail is a privacy-first utility that provides instant temporary email addresses. These are used to protect your real identity and primary inbox from junk mail, spam, and data-gathering websites.
FAQ.a5: No. Once an email is deleted (either manually or by the 60-minute timer), it is permanently wiped from our RAM-based storage. We do not keep backups or archival data.
FAQ.a6: Some websites maintain 'blacklists' of common temporary email domains. By providing multiple domains, we allow you to bypass these restrictions and sign up for services that might block others.
FAQ.a7: Yes, our system parses full MIME content. While we focus on making the text and HTML content readable, we also allow you to see and process message structures completely.
FAQ.support_desc: Our goal is to provide the most reliable temporary email service on the web. If you're experiencing issues or have suggestions, our community is here to help.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.sec1_desc: DisposeMail is built on the principle of minimal data collection. We do not require registration, names, or any personal identification to use our service.
Privacy.sec2_desc: All emails and addresses are automatically purged after **60 minutes**. We do not maintain backups, logs, or archival copies of any transmitted data.
Privacy.sec3_desc: We do not use tracking cookies. We may use essential session cookies to remember your current temporary address for the duration of your visit.
Privacy.sec4_desc: We use third-party advertising partners (like Google AdSense) to keep our service free. These partners may use non-personal data to provide relevant advertisements.
Privacy.sec5_desc: All traffic is encrypted via SSL/TLS. Our infrastructure is hardened to prevent unauthorized access and ensure your temporary data remains private.
